watch.summary: A Rocket League streamer hypes himself up while scoring back-to-back goals against his opponent.

beats.what: Streamer scores a goal and trash talks his opponent.
He lines up another shot on goal in slow-mo focus.
The ball explodes into the net for a goal.
Kickoff resets and he pushes forward saying 'I'm angry'.
He scores yet another goal to finish the montage sequence.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Easy, get him out of here bro! Get him out of my face!
watch.why: This clip focuses on gameplay hype and energetic confidence rather than comedic subversion or twists. It functions as a high-energy highlights clip rather than a comedy bit.
